Privacy

Your information.
Your choice.

A simple explanation of this website and its enquiry process.

Enquiry form

The form prepares a message locally in your browser. This version has no enquiry database and does not submit form details to a website server. No medical records or test results are requested.

WhatsApp & external websites

When you choose Open WhatsApp, your prepared message is passed to WhatsApp. Sending the message is your choice and is governed by that service’s privacy practices. Facebook and research links also open external services.

Hosting & analytics

No advertising trackers or analytics scripts are added by this website. The hosting platform and external services may process technical access information under their own policies. This site uses system fonts and locally hosted images.

Appointments & payments

An enquiry does not reserve an appointment. Session details, availability, fees, travel costs and any cancellation arrangements are agreed with Farra directly. This website does not collect payments.

Images & content

Generated product and service photographs are styled illustrations. Event posters are supplied promotional materials preserved for historical reference. Device visuals use client-supplied references; exact models and accessories may differ. Farra’s portrait is an AI-edited version of her public profile portrait. No patient before-and-after photographs or invented testimonials are used.

Contact

For questions about enquiries you have sent, contact Farra on +60 12-275 4883.
